prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE original full-bleed vertical 9:16 watercolor story illustration for one locked narration shot. Use every input according to its explicitly labelled role; preserve the existing named identities, not just their species. Input 1: identity for 团团 (tuantuan), preserve exactly: 暖棕圆脸、蓬松弯尾、奶油色胸前、小耳朵。 Input 1: clothing only for 团团: 暗赭色小围巾 Input 2: identity for 绒绒 (rongrong), preserve exactly: 浅棕绒毛、圆耳、米色口鼻。 Input 2: clothing only for 绒绒: 暗绿小马甲 Input 3: environment layout / watercolor style ONLY. Keep the geography and furnishings, but draw ONLY the requested people and props for this shot, never copy unwanted actors. This is not an image to reuse as the output.
Visible characters: 团团 (tuantuan), 绒绒 (rongrong). Exact total number of visible characters: 2. Do not draw extra background animals. Standing body-height ratios (not ear or tail tips): 团团 0.9. Tuantuan wears the short dark ochre/rust scarf. Scene continuity: creek_shallows；小溪浅水滩
The SINGLE visual moment and framing: 团团与绒绒在浅滩边轮流打水漂，石片贴水跳跃，二人兴奋欢呼、眼神跟随石片。
Mandatory pose/prop state (overrides neutral model-sheet poses): 保持角色身份一致；表情、目光、耳姿与身体动作贴合本镜具体旁白，温和自然，不复制参考图的默认表情；水彩竖屏9:16；无字无水印；重要脸部和动作避开字幕区。
Style: hand-painted gentle watercolor on fine warm paper, muted natural hues, soft edges and rounded shapes, quiet storybook mood, no glossy 3D or photorealism. Daylight scenes use soft greens and warm daylight, not bedroom amber tint. Night scenes use soft warm lamplight and muted gray-blue windows. Composition: full-bleed vertical 9:16. Keep all important faces, hands, feet, biscuits, fabric folds and other story actions in the upper 68% of the image. Bottom 32% is low-detail negative space for later subtitles, with no crucial objects there. Make the specified story state visually understandable. Text: NONE. No words, labels, subtitles, numbers, logos, watermark, speech bubbles, panels, frames or collage. Do not reproduce model sheets, multiple versions of a character, or wardrobe lineups. Each named character appears exactly once. This is a new single coherent scene, not a copy of the references. No motion streaks or implied camera zoom. Never turn a metaphor into a real transformation: yellow blankets remain fabric, imagined grassy softness is not actual grass growing in bed. No new story events.
